title: fastroute rule draft (format_version 1.x)
description: A set of routing rules proposed by a person, a script or an AI model, before anything is executed. Structure only: `fastroute rules check` adds the checks that a schema cannot express (evidence quotes, the design's baseline, capability of the engine, relaxations). A draft contains rules and never routing geometry.

format_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR; minor versions only add properties

tool.description: free text; no particular AI service is assumed

design.description: which design the rules are for (SHA-256 of the DSN / of inspect.json), so that a draft is not applied to another board

inputs.description: everything the rules are derived from; every rule must point into one of these

text.description: natural_language: the requirement as written; quotes in evidence must occur in it

applies_to.description: exactly one of nets, net_class, all

input.description: id of an entry of inputs

quote.description: natural_language / human: the words that ask for this rule; must occur in the input text

ref.description: design_data / reference_board: what was read, e.g. nets[USB_DP].class

strength.description: hard: must hold, a violation fails the board. soft: a preference the router may trade off. unknown: the value cannot be determined from the inputs (impedance, current, timing): no value is given, `needed` says what is missing, never executed. unsupported: the engine cannot enforce it (value recorded for the record), never executed.

params.description: kind specific numbers in mm / ohm / A / ps; never coordinates, traces or vias

needed.description: unknown: what has to be provided to make this a real rule

relaxes.description: declares that this rule loosens a limit that the design already has; without it a loosening is rejected, with it a human must accept it explicitly

parameter.description: the params key that is loosened

baseline.description: the design's current limit; checked against the design data
